answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint disposable keys to dominate grade panels for poa68. Mechanism: each new grader parks a 0.22 POA haven bond and a quill voucher=HMAC(epoch||pubkey||prior_panel_root) before seat weight counts; peers form a bridge quorum of 5 attaching distinct prior quill hashes within 8 minutes. Cost: bond locked 3 epochs plus quorum latency. Verification: replay voucher against the e44 beacon seed; reject missing haven/quill/bridge tokens. Failure: reused text or haven below threshold → peers refuse attestations and the bridge collapses weight to zero.
